decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Site Plans 100Ground Floor - Existing 00.100Ground Floor - Proposed 00.101Ground Floor - Proposed Block Plan 00.101.01First Floor - Existing 01.100First Floor - Proposed 01.101Rear Elevation - Existing & Proposed 203Side Elevation - Existing 201Side Elevation - Proposed 202SuDS ProformaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
description: Single storey rear infill extension involving demolition of existing conservatory.
